author: N6rL
content:
## Plan

### 1. alcanzai-core/Cargo.toml — add clap dep
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] } in [dependencies] (binaries under src/bin/ use the crate's regular deps).

### 2. alcanzai-core/src/bin/alcanzai.rs — CLI binary
clap derive-macro CLI with subcommand tree:
  alcanzai vault regenerate --library <PATH> --vault <PATH> [--note-subdir <PATH>]
  alcanzai vault render     --library <PATH> --vault <PATH> [--note-subdir <PATH>]

Uses SqliteLibrary::open + VaultProjection::rebuild / render. Errors printed to stderr, exits 1.

### 3. alcanzai-core/tests/vault_rebuild_integration.rs — §6 test #5
Three KOs ingested via SqliteLibrary::open_in_memory:
  - academic_pdf: title, authors, year, abstract, DOI, arXiv, content blocks + enrichment
  - web_article: title, source_plugin=web, no abstract, minimal blocks
  - unknown: no title, no year, no abstract (exercises all-None paths)

Test flow:
  rebuild → collect HashMap<filename, content>
  fs::remove_dir_all(vault_root)
  rebuild again → collect HashMap<filename, content>
  assert_eq! both maps

Also: test that render after rebuild is a no-op (all files already up-to-date; watermark newer than all updated_at). This proves incremental render correctness.

Both tests use open_in_memory + tempfile::TempDir — no external services needed, no #[ignore].
